purpose: Guarantee every Founder-facing QC artifact is readable from the governed RDP operator account without weakening internal artifact permissions.
invariants: WAITING_FOUNDER_QC must reference a Founder-readable qc alias, not a private internal derivative.
QC alias content must remain exact-byte/hash lineage-linked to its internal delivery artifact.
QC alias must be owner-readable and die-runtime-group-readable, never world-readable.
Permission normalization must not grant submission, publication, account, spend or provider authority.
Legacy parked QC aliases are reconciled to the same readability invariant without changing bytes.
